_about: Real public sites, scanned live (12 pages each). Every expectation below was checked by hand against the real pages on 2026-11-13. must = a real problem findable has to report; must_not = a false alarm findable used to raise and must never raise again. Live sites change, so a failure can also mean the site changed: re-check by hand before changing code.

sites.why: the served HTML has 1 word; everything renders in the browser
/sitemap.xml is 404; /chat redirects to Discord and must not be judged as a svelte.dev page
sitemap lists /careers which 301s to /careers/; /blog moves to blog.cloudflare.com (another site)
posts have no meta description; sitemap URLs outside /news must be ignored
images use a bare alt (valid, decorative); sitemap URLs end in / and must be fetched as written
no sitemap; python.org -> www.python.org is one site
sitemap URLs end in /; the /uv prefix must not be doubled
